raw:
Most of these rest on three mechanisms:

- **Disconnected paths:** an edit on a dead branch does nothing.
- **Diminishing returns:** adding capacity helps less when the parent already has plenty.
- **Replaced op:** an edit helps most when it replaces `none`.

I did not run any experiments or check these against NAS-Bench-201 data; they are structural predictions.
